item.title: Draft ministerial ordinance to preserve machinery-safety protections for interns and volunteers
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare published a draft ministerial ordinance on 2026-11-20 to amend Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Ordinance No. 29 of 2026, concerning implementation of amendments to the Industrial Safety and Health Act and the Working Environment Measurement Act. The draft would retain an employer duty under Article 27 of the Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health to prevent use of machinery lacking prescribed standards or safety devices, excluding cases covered by Article 42(2) and (3) of the Industrial Safety and Health Act (Act No. 57 of 1972). The explanatory excerpt identifies a potential protection gap arising from the earlier deletion of Article 27 for people who are neither workers nor covered working officers or sole proprietors, such as interns and volunteers. The stated comment deadline is 2026-12-19 15:00 JST. Promulgation is planned for late February 2027, with commencement on the promulgation date. Original title: 労働安全衛生法及び作業環境測定法の一部を改正する法律の一部の施行に伴う関係省令の整備等に関する省令の一部を改正する省令案に関する御意見の募集について Public Comment Open | e-Gov Public Comment | Published 2026-11-20 | First detected 2026-11-22 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: Draft maritime radio amendments: AMRD, fishing-vessel equipment and four-digit VHF channels
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications published draft Ministerial Ordinance and related amendments for public comment on 2026-11-21, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-21 at 23:59 JST. The proposals would amend existing radio-station standards and related instruments to introduce Autonomous Maritime Radio Devices (AMRD), which use AIS technology to assist person-overboard rescue and the detection, location and avoidance of fishing gear. They would also reflect radio-equipment quantities for qualifying fishing vessels under the Cape Town Agreement, which the announcement says is expected to enter into force on 2027-02-24. Related notice amendments would support four-digit international VHF channels; the announcement cites an IMO circular specifying adaptation by the first radio-station inspection on or after 2028-01-01. The excerpts do not establish a commencement date for the proposed domestic amendments. Original title: 無線局（基幹放送局を除く。）の開設の根本的基準等の一部を改正する省令案等に係る意見募集 － 自律型海上無線機器（AMRD）の導入等のための制度整備 － Public Comment Open | e-Gov Public Comment | Published 2026-11-21 | First detected 2026-11-22 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: Draft Notice to Add Locker and Designated-Location Delivery to Standard Parcel Delivery Terms
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism published a draft amending Notice for public comment on 2026-11-20, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-11 23:59 JST. It would amend the Standard Parcel Delivery Terms and Conditions (Ministry of Transport Notice No. 576 of 1990), established under Article 10(3) of the Motor Truck Transportation Business Act (Act No. 83 of 1989), which the explanatory text says presently provides only for face-to-face handover. Proposed Article 11(2) would allow delivery by a sender- or recipient-designated method, including secure parcel lockers or an appropriate recipient-designated location, to count as handover to the recipient; sender designation would require agreement with the recipient, and delivery would require written or electronic notification to the recipient. Promulgation is planned for mid-December 2026, with proposed commencement on 2027-04-01. Contracts concluded before commencement would remain subject to the previous terms.
